name: bug
description: Existing behavior fails or produces an incorrect result

name: documentation
description: Documentation, examples, or API reference work

name: enhancement
description: A feature idea or implementation of an approved feature

name: dependencies
description: Dependency updates

name: javascript
description: JavaScript dependency updates identified by Dependabot

name: regression
description: Behavior worked in an earlier version and now fails

name: breaking-change
description: Breaks an existing caller workflow or public contract

name: needs-triage
description: The report needs initial assessment

name: needs-info
description: A specific missing detail prevents progress

name: confirmed
description: The reported problem has been established, without promising a fix

name: blocked:upstream
description: Progress requires a verified Fluxer platform change

name: duplicate
description: Another report already owns this problem

name: out-of-scope
description: The report falls outside the contribution policy

name: not-planned
description: The request was considered and declined

name: scope:approved
description: Maintainer approved the direction and scope, without granting contributor permission

name: vouch:trusted
description: PR author has general contribution permission

name: vouch:unvouched
description: PR author has no general vouch status and needs issue-specific permission

name: pr:allowed
description: The issue has an active permission grant for at least one named contributor

name: permission:issue
description: PR author has a verified permission grant for a linked issue

name: help wanted
description: Contribution is actively sought, with permission still required

name: good first issue
description: A bounded task with sufficient guidance for a newcomer, with permission still required
